scope: Broaden successful-state coverage while retaining all failed evaluations

corpus_selection.rule: Re-run every passing parent condition with actor observations; require all re-runs to pass before corpus construction. Preserve failed captures and abort rather than silently shrink coverage.
corpus_selection.scope: Previously observed successful conditions; no new validation used for training

comparators: Retained narrow reference80/reference81 and unconstrained80/unconstrained81 from identical parent, seeds and budget, plus parent itself. Re-evaluate every policy on identical conditions.
protocol: 15s, sensors/sensors, physics_step, require_motion_progress; existing gates unchanged
analysis: Report paired fixes and regressions against parent and same-seed narrow/unconstrained controls, with every changed case and fall. Report known/training-exposed and fresh conditions separately.
promotion: Requires all conditions to pass before separate integrated qualification. No policy selection based only on aggregate gains.
